title: Supported finite scalar model hull
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and indexing universe of [def-weil-size-convention], put $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and use the ordinary uncompleted module-object category [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A support chain is a finite chain $W\to\cdots\to X$, each arrow a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] or a closed immersion with quasi-compact open complement [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Its ordinary extension functor $J$ composes open extension by zero [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] and closed direct image [def-sfb-module-lower-star]; the empty chain gives the identity. A finite scalar local model means the finite constant local model of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Define $\mathcal G_X$ to be the intersection of all full replete classes $P$ containing $(JL)[0]$ for every such chain and finite scalar local model $L$ on $W$, containing zero, closed under all integer shifts and distinguished-triangle extensions [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory], closed under retract diagrams $K\xrightarrow{i}L\xrightarrow{p}K$ with $pi=1_K$, and closed under all small products in the ordinary derived category [def-weil-category-product]. In addition, if $I$ is a small filtered category and $C:I\to\mathrm{CoCh}(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$ is a strict diagram with one integer $a$ such that $C_i^n=0$ for every $i$ and $n<a$, then $Q(C_i)\in P$ for every $i$ implies $Q(\varinjlim_I C_i)\in P$, with the colimit taken termwise in module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Replete means closed under isomorphisms. For qcqs $X$ this is exactly the supported model hull in the descent obligation.
